title: Te Puna i raro i te Oneone
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka o te Quran, i tūtaki tētahi tangata manawanui nui ki tētahi whakamātautau ka pakaru ai ngā ngākau toa. I tangohia ngā mea katoa - te taonga, te whānau, me te hauora. Heoi, mai i te hohonutanga o te ngakau pouri, i whakautua tētahi inoi whakaiti i te huarahi tino ohorere. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei wairua e pāorooro ana te kōrero mō te whakaoranga i roto i ngā tau?
clues: I whakamatautauria ahau ki tētahi whakamātautau tino kino, ā, e maumaharatia tonutia ana e ngā tau katoa.
I ngaro i ahau ngā mea nui katoa - aku taonga, aku tamariki, me tōku hauora.
Kī tonu tōku tinana i ngā mate pāwera, ā, i whakarērea ahau e te katoa.
I roto i tōku pouri, ka karanga ahau ki a Allah, me te mea kua pā mai a Hātana ki ahau ki te mamae me te whakamamae.
Nāwai ā, ka whakahoki mai a Allah ki ahau, ā, ka whakahau mai ia kia patua e ahau te whenua ki tōku waewae.
Mai i taua wāhi tonu, ka pupū mai he puna matao, ā, ka whakahokia mai e Atua tōku whānau, ka tāruatia hoki rātou hei tohu aroha.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
